name: Paradox
summary: Conversational recruiting software automating applications, screening and scheduling for high-volume hiring.
description: Paradox provides a conversational ATS and candidate experience agent for frontline and high-volume hiring. It automates applications, screening, interview scheduling, events, CRM and onboarding through chat and mobile, and offers a career site builder. No public prices are listed; access is through sales. The company reports reductions in cost per hire for its customers. Its candidate experience agent works alongside an existing system of record instead of replacing it.

howToUse.title: Screen applications and schedule interviews
howToUse.description: Run conversational applications, screening, and interview scheduling in chat and on mobile. The candidate experience agent works alongside an existing system of record instead of replacing it.

howToUse.title: Handle events, CRM, and onboarding
howToUse.description: Continue with conversational events, conversational CRM, and onboarding, then use the career site builder in Career Site Studio.

features_fr: Logiciel de recrutement conversationnel automatisant les candidatures, la sélection et la planification pour les recrutements à volume élevé.
Paradox fournit un ATS conversationnel et un agent d'expérience candidat pour les recrutements de première ligne et à volume élevé.
Il automatise les candidatures, la sélection, la planification des entretiens, les événements, le CRM et l'intégration via le chat et le mobile, et propose un créateur de site de carrière.
Aucun prix public n'est indiqué ; l’accès se fait par la vente.
